statements.query: MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(:GCPVpc)-[:RESOURCE]->(:GCPFirewall)<-[:ALLOWED_BY|DENIED_BY]-(:GCPIpRule)<-[r:MEMBER_OF_IP_RULE]-() WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (r) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Remove GCP IpRule-to-IpRange/Ipv6Range relationships that are out of date. Directions match ingestion: (range)-[:MEMBER_OF_IP_RULE]->(rule)-[:ALLOWED_BY|DENIED_BY]->(firewall). Range nodes are shared by every tenant, so only the edge is removed.

statements.query: MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(:GCPVpc)-[:RESOURCE]->(:GCPFirewall)<-[:ALLOWED_BY|DENIED_BY]-(n:GCPIpRule) WHERE n.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DETACH DELETE (n) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Delete GCP Ip Rules that no longer exist and detach them from all previously connected nodes.

statements.query: MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(:GCPVpc)-[:RESOURCE]->(:GCPFirewall)<-[r:ALLOWED_BY|DENIED_BY]-(:GCPIpRule) WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (r) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Remove GCP Firewall-to-IpRule relationships that are out of date.

statements.query: MATCH (:GCPPublicIpAddress)<-[r:MEMBER_OF_PUBLIC_IP_ADDRESS]-(:GCPFirewall)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPVpc)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (r) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Remove GCP Firewall-to-PublicIpAddress relationships that are out of date. GCPPublicIpAddress nodes are keyed by the address or range (e.g. Google's health-check 35.191.0.0/16) and shared by every tenant and by Cloud SQL, and their lastupdated is the last writer's tag: only this project's edge is removed here.

statements.query: MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(:GCPVpc)-[:RESOURCE]->(:GCPFirewall)-[r:TARGET_TAG]->(:GCPNetworkTag) WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (r) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Remove GCP Firewall-to-NetworkTag relationships that are out of date. Instance TAGGED edges are cleaned in GCP instance cleanup; tag nodes are kept.

statements.query: MATCH (n:GCPFirewall)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPVpc)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE n.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DETACH DELETE (n) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Delete GCP Firewalls that no longer exist and detach them from all previously connected nodes.

statements.query: MATCH (:GCPFirewall)<-[r:RESOURCE]-(:GCPVpc)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (r) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Remove GCP VPC-to-Firewall relationships that are out of date.

statements.query: MATCH (n:GCPPublicIpAddress) WHERE NOT (n)--() AND n.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (n) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Orphan sweep, tenant-independent: delete a public address once no firewall or SQL instance of any tenant links it.
